title: The Rainbow Fruit Quest
description: Three friends set out to find the magical Rainbow Fruit hidden deep in the Whispering Forest to save their village from endless rain.

scenes.description: Wide shot of lush green forest edge after rain, mist curling between tall trees, Tara standing at front holding a basket.
scenes.visual_prompt: (lush green forest edge:1.3) with mist, tall wet trees, (girl Tara:1.2) holding woven basket, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), bright fresh colors, wide shot
scenes.narration: बारिश से भीगे जंगल के किनारे, तारा अपने दोस्तों के साथ तैयार खड़ी थी, गाँव के लिए जादुई फल खोजने।
scenes.subtitle: At the Forest Edge

scenes.description: Medium shot of Tara talking to Aarav and Chintu, pointing toward a glowing path inside the forest.
scenes.visual_prompt: (three kids:1.3) standing together, (girl Tara:1.2) pointing toward glowing path in forest, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), warm diffused light, medium shot
scenes.narration: तारा ने आरव और चिंटू को जंगल के अंदर चमकते रास्ते की ओर इशारा किया।
scenes.subtitle: The Glowing Path

scenes.description: Side shot of friends stepping over mossy stones along a small stream, sunlight breaking through leaves.
scenes.visual_prompt: (three kids:1.3) stepping carefully over mossy stones beside small stream, sunlight through green leaves, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), side shot
scenes.narration: वे काई लगे पत्थरों पर कदम रखते हुए एक छोटी धारा के किनारे आगे बढ़े।
scenes.subtitle: Stream Crossing

scenes.description: Overhead view of a giant friendly turtle with colorful shell patterns carrying the kids across a pond.
scenes.visual_prompt: (giant cartoon turtle:1.3) with colorful patterned shell, carrying (three kids:1.2) on its back across calm pond, sparkles on water, (storybook whimsical style:1.4), overhead view
scenes.narration: एक विशाल कछुए ने उन्हें अपनी पीठ पर बैठाकर तालाब पार कराया।
scenes.subtitle: The Turtle Ride

scenes.description: Close-up of a talking squirrel holding a tiny umbrella, pointing toward a rainbow arch deep in the forest.
scenes.visual_prompt: (cartoon squirrel:1.3) holding small umbrella, pointing with paw toward rainbow arch in forest, big expressive eyes, (storybook whimsical style:1.4), close-up
scenes.narration: एक बोलती गिलहरी ने उन्हें जंगल के भीतर बने इंद्रधनुषी मेहराब की ओर इशारा किया।
scenes.subtitle: The Helpful Squirrel

scenes.description: Wide shot of a magical tree with golden leaves and a single glowing rainbow fruit hanging from a branch.
scenes.visual_prompt: (large magical tree:1.4) with golden leaves, one glowing rainbow fruit on branch, soft magical light all around, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), wide shot
scenes.narration: आख़िरकार, उन्होंने सुनहरे पत्तों वाले पेड़ को देखा, जिस पर एक चमकता इंद्रधनुषी फल लटक रहा था।
scenes.subtitle: The Rainbow Fruit Tree

scenes.description: Medium shot of Tara plucking the fruit carefully while Aarav and Chintu hold the basket ready.
scenes.visual_prompt: (girl Tara:1.2) gently plucking glowing rainbow fruit, (Aarav and Chintu:1.2) holding woven basket, warm magical light on faces, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), medium shot
scenes.narration: तारा ने सावधानी से फल तोड़ा, और आरव-चिंटू ने टोकरा आगे किया।
scenes.subtitle: Picking the Fruit

scenes.description: Pull-back shot of kids returning to their sunny village, villagers cheering as rainbow light spreads.
scenes.visual_prompt: (three kids:1.3) walking toward happy village, rainbow light spreading in sky, smiling villagers, (storybook cartoon style:1.4), pull-back wide shot
scenes.narration: जब वे गाँव लौटे, तो इंद्रधनुषी रौशनी फैल गई और सबने खुशी मनाई।
scenes.subtitle: Home in the Light
